description: This public Zenodo record supplies field reference data for separating irrigated from non-irrigated cropland in two different agro-climatic settings. Its file inventory has three ZIP archives, named for France in 2023 and 2025 and Almaty, Kazakhstan, in 2025. The article presents them as in situ reference observations for optical and radar-based irrigation mapping. Zenodo states CC BY 4.0. These are labelled fields for map training or checking, not a continuous meter record of applied water or a complete inventory of every irrigated parcel in either country. The two-country sample, differences between the collection years and local field-label procedures are limitations for transferring a classifier to another basin. A reviewer-assessed use is checking simulated or remotely mapped irrigation extent against observed field labels. model-fao-aquacrop is a related crop-water model, but no record-level linkage or input conversion was tested. A rejected round-one candidate covers this same DOI; the current public release and its three named archives now meet the user’s reuse rule. No archive was downloaded.
